prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent raster game asset for Kanab Quest, a French hemp farm cartoon management game. Match the established Sylvain art direction: confident dark ink outlines, cheerful hand-painted textured cream, teal, warm apricot orange and golden paper, rounded mildly irregular perspective. No photorealism, no text, no letters, no UI, no wheat, no characters or hands. Real alpha transparency, no background rectangle, no checkerboard rendered into the image. Asset type: a 3:2 wide scenery cutout, 1536x1024 composition. A charming SMALL personnel office/study table, viewed straight on slightly from above, front legs and rounded tabletop. The tabletop runs from x12% to x91%, at y65%, thin teal front apron below. Lower legs end at y94%. Entire top55% of image must remain TRANSPARENT and EMPTY so a separate live avatar can stand behind table at x39%, head around y20%. No chair or high furniture behind avatar. On far right tabletop x85% a small apricot ceramic pot with one small hemp seedling, only rising to y45%; far left edge x17% a small short teal pencil cup. Most tabletop empty for separate contract or open book prop. No folder, no book, no tools. Illustrated silhouette with generous transparent padding, restrained contact shadow only beneath feet. This is welcoming staffing/study furniture, not industrial equipment.
